concept.title: Team Collaboration
concept.shortdesc: Share a scene collection and control access to it across a team.

conbody.p: A Studio Pro scene collection can be shared with teammates on the same StreamForge account's team. Shared collections sync automatically, and role-based permissions control who can edit sources and filters versus who can only switch scenes during a live session.
Two roles are available: Editor, who can change anything in the shared collection, and Operator, who can switch scenes and start/stop recording or streaming but cannot modify sources or filters.
